observations: Photo 0, 1, 2 show a used automatic transmission/gearbox assembly with starter motor and solenoid still attached.
Casing is heavily dusted with grease, oil residue and surface grime; no visible corrosion holes.
Photo 1 shows bare, cut wiring harness ends coming out of a connector, not plugged into anything.
Photo 2 shows the bell-housing side with torque converter visible, consistent with an automatic transaxle.
A watermark 'GOD OF ABRAHAM INVESTMENT' overlays all three photos; no manufacturer tag, part-number sticker, or engine code plate is legible in any shot.
No vehicle, make, model, or engine code is shown or stated by the seller.

claims.claim: Dealer in all kinds of Japanese parts and gearbox
claims.evidence: No shop signage, business registration, or vehicle-specific tag is visible in any photo.

claims.claim: Implied this is a working/functional gearbox for sale
claims.evidence: No video of the gearbox shifting, no bench test, no fluid check shown.

risks.risk: Unknown vehicle fitment (make, model, engine code) which drives most of the price
risks.proof: A clear photo of the part-number/VIN tag stamped on the casing, or seller statement with proof of source vehicle plate/chassis
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this, since gearbox value is fitment-specific

risks.risk: Internal wear, gear slip, or solenoid failure not visible externally
risks.proof: Video of the transmission being turned by hand/bench-tested, or a shift-quality test on a running vehicle

risks.risk: Cut/open wiring harness in photo 1 could indicate missing or damaged mechatronic unit
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the full harness and connector showing it is intact and terminates properly

risks.risk: Mileage and prior accident/flood history unknown
risks.proof: Photo of odometer from the donor vehicle or any paperwork linking part to vehicle

proof_requests: Photo of the stamped part-number/model tag on the transmission casing
Statement and photo of the exact donor vehicle (make, model, year, engine code)
Video of the gearbox being tested (manual rotation or bench test) showing no grinding or slipping
Close-up of the wiring harness in photo 1 showing it is complete and undamaged
response.reason: No part-number tag or vehicle fitment is visible or stated, so even a worst-case price bracket cannot be set until the make/model/engine code of the donor vehicle is confirmed.
